subject: The strategic plan for horizon-aligner, emphasizing composition, streaming GFA, and localized E-graphs

claims.summary: We are replacing arbitrary affine gap penalties and scoring matrices with Information-Theoretic bit-savings (MDL).

source.quote: We are replacing arbitrary affine gap penalties and scoring matrices with Information-Theoretic bit-savings (MDL).

claims.summary: vg and odgi crash on 12GB pangenomes due to RAM exhaustion. Our custom zero-copy GFA streaming parser (src/gfa/mod.rs) solves the I/O bottleneck entirely.

source.quote: `vg` and `odgi` crash on 12GB pangenomes due to RAM exhaustion. Our custom zero-copy GFA streaming parser (`src/gfa/mod.rs`) solves the I/O bottleneck entirely.

claims.summary: Cactus introduced the .hal format, which required heavy C-dependencies (libhdf5), fractured the ecosystem, and made downstream parsing difficult in other languages.

source.quote: `Cactus` introduced the `.hal` format, which required heavy C-dependencies (`libhdf5`), fractured the ecosystem, and made downstream parsing difficult in other languages.

claims.summary: We will never invent a proprietary binary format. Our tools will communicate purely by streaming standard GFA (v1.0/v1.1) and standard MAF/VCF over stdin/stdout.

source.quote: We will **never invent a proprietary binary format**. Our tools will communicate purely by streaming standard GFA (v1.0/v1.1) and standard MAF/VCF over `stdin`/`stdout`.
